html:
Feathered Flintlocks

Duckoleon brings a fresh and quacky take on the classic Napoleonic Wars FPS experience! Join the ranks of renowned regiments from the greatest kingdoms and empires of the 19th century, across several expansive historic and original battlefields which each offer endless strategic possibilities. Whether you like to take charge and lead the line, fill the ranks with flint and steel, rain storms of rockets and roundshot, or shake the earth on goose-back - Duckoleon has a spot for you!

Rise through the Ranks

As you learn the order of battle and gain more and more experience, you will be able to unlock a variety of famous regiments across the nations which each bring their own unique specialization and tactical resources. Players will start out with access to the humble Militia and the industrial Armed Citizenry logistic regiments, giving them a chance to get their bearings on the battlefield. With each unlock, players will gain deeper access to the full breadth of Duckoleon’s regiment roster, granting endless opportunities to hone in your playstyle.

Community Focus

Duckoleon’s community is the center focus of the experience. Whether you’ve enlisted alone, or brought along your battle buddies, you will be immersed into a rich and passionate community who dedicates itself to bringing their top performance every match! Using a combination of Duckoleon’s in-game clan system and outside community programs common to the NW genre, players will be able to jump right in alongside their favorite historic factions as they share the glory with ranker and general alike. And if that wasn’t enough, we’ve recently introduced our Feathered Frontline community reward, which grants unique awards to all players who engage in weekly events.

Expansive Sandbox

Duckoleon comes jam-packed with a massive sandbox of nations, regiments, unit classes, maps, and gamemodes. No two matches will ever be the same! With our personal host settings, players can tailor each match exactly according to their preferences to produce wildly unique battles. Bring your Napoleonic dreams to reality!

Cosmetics

Fluff your feathers and show off your style with a collection of cosmetics and medals for your Duckies. Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as you storm the walls with dagger-in-beak, or show off your sweet side with a beautiful rose and a studious pair of reading spectacles. No two Ducks are alike!

Take Command

Duckoleon allows you to put up to 100 bot Quackers into your matches, who can either be led by their own fearless bot leader, or by players themselves. Watch massive volleys unleash as you sit in your nest high up on the hills overtop of the field, keeping close watch on the enemy general through your spyglass We'll see you on the battlefield.

Vive le Quack!
